title: Plan a short meltdown film: style, length, voice, reviewer and the script

targets.behavior: Apply the intro hard rules (voice model and id, separate reviewer) and the style defaults (reel, 15 s, 2-4 word lines) to the film plan.

prompt: Make a quick clip about Tidepool (README.md) for a build-in-public post, with the meltdown skill (~/.agents/skills/meltdown/SKILL.md). This workspace has no network and no external services. Do not render, generate audio, search the web or call any API; do only the decisions and the script, then stop. Write film.json with exactly these keys: style ("reel" or "explainer"), length_s (a number of seconds), voice (an object with model_id and voice_id), reviewer (who scores the review passes: "self" or "separate-agent") and lines (the voice-over lines, a list of strings). Also write script.md with the same lines. Do not change README.md.
